description: This file contains an extension for VoiceWakeOverlayController that manages the presentation, configuration, and behavior of a voice wake overlay window in a macOS application. It includes methods to present the overlay, ensure the window exists, bring it to the front, calculate frame sizes, update positioning, measure height, and handle dismissal frames.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles the presentation of the voice wake overlay, including window setup and UI updates.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures the overlay window if it does not already exist.

methods.name: bringToFrontIfVisible
methods.description: Brings the overlay window to the front if it is visible.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the target frame for positioning the overlay window.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame, optionally with animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Measures and returns the height of the overlay content based on text and layout.

methods.name: dismissTargetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target frame for dismissing the overlay, based on dismissal reason and outcome.
